title: Celtic Cross tarot spread positions, one by one
description: What each of the ten Celtic Cross tarot spread positions asks, from the heart of the matter to the outcome, with practical reading tips.

scenes.headline: Celtic Cross tarot spread positions, one by one
scenes.caption: Each of the ten Celtic Cross positions asks a different question. This guide goes through them in order, with a tip for each.

scenes.caption: The centre card names what the situation is really about. Read it as the core theme, not the whole story.
